strongest_new_material_result.statement: Inserted/removable phalli are independently documented across Egyptian objects, and KHM INV 10077 provides an Osiris-specific example where penis and testicles were formed separately and inserted into an oval recess.

strongest_new_material_result.interpretation: Mechanical detachability/loss is materially plausible as an object failure mode. No source presently links such a failure during ritual to the origin of the Osiris missing-phallus narrative.

current_verdict: The most important positive result is technological: detachable/inserted phalli are real Egyptian object construction, including an Osiris-specific example. The shared-mandrel hypothesis is not rejected; it is blocked pending comparable genital metrology. The Mendes female mirror branch is active but has not yet produced a gold genital counterpart.
